intent: A filterable catalogue of integrations: search, a category filter with an optional Connected segment, and one tile per provider that ends in a status word (Not connected, Connected, Connecting…, Coming soon) and at most one action (Connect or Manage). connectFlow "detail" opens a Drawer with what it can access and Connect or Disconnect. Built on kit Input, SegmentedControl, Button, Badge, Drawer and Empty.
useWhen: let people find and connect integrations in settings or onboarding
list providers that are coming soon
an Integrations or Apps area where people read what an app can access before connecting (connectFlow "detail")
doNotUseWhen: settings for one connected integration — the integration-settings pattern
a plain list of links — LinkList

items.note: { id, name, description, category?, status: 'available'|'connected'|'comingSoon', icon?, publisher?, about?, permissions?: string[], connectedNote? }[]. publisher, about, permissions and connectedNote show in the connectFlow "detail" drawer.

category.note: "all", "connected" (the Connected segment, with showConnected) or a category name.

showConnected.note: Adds a "Connected n" segment after All; its value is "connected".

connectFlow.note: detail: Connect and Manage open a Drawer with the item's detail, what it can access, and Connect or Disconnect.

tileSize.note: compact: name, description and the word or action on one row.

onConnect.note: (id) => void. Direct: the tile's Connect. Detail: the drawer's Connect.

onManage.note: (id) => void. Direct: the tile's Manage on a connected item. Detail: Manage opens the drawer.

onDisconnect.note: (id) => void. Detail: Disconnect in a connected item's drawer.

selectedId.note: Detail, controlled: the item whose drawer is open, or null.

connectingId.note: That tile reads Connecting… as a status word, with no button, announced in a status region.

onRequest.note: Request an integration, when search finds nothing.

requirements: search is a labelled kit Input; the category filter is a kit SegmentedControl radio group, and Connected is a radio in it with its count in the name
each tile action is described by the provider name
every tile ends in a status word, not colour alone; Connecting and Coming soon have no button, so nothing disabled sits in the tab order
Connecting is announced in a status region
the detail drawer is a kit Drawer (dialog, focus trap, Escape, focus returns to the tile action)
tiles fade and rise in when the filter changes, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local IntegrationGrid or AppDirectory
Do not use a real provider's logo or name without labelling it an example
Do not put more than one action on a tile
Do not put a disabled Connect on a coming-soon or connecting tile; the status word says it
snippet: <IntegrationPicker note="example providers" items={integrations} showConnected connectFlow="detail" onConnect={connect} onDisconnect={disconnect} connectingId={connecting} onRequest={request} />
